title.value: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

status.provenance: Introduced by M. of A. GALLAGHER, STERN, GONZALEZ-ROJAS, JACOBSON, LEVENBERG, SIMON, SIMONE, ROSENTHAL, COLTON, REYES, SHIMSKY, RAGA, CLARK, SEAWRIGHT, FORREST, OTIS, BURDICK, MAMDANI, MEEKS

pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section

date.provenance:
February 4, 2025
This act shall take effect immediately.

who.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes

products.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes

value: written assurance of the manufacturer that product meets requirements
exceptions.provenance: if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this section. Such written assurance shall take the form of a certificate of compliance stating that such product is in compliance with the requirements of this section.
